## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION: Mixed signals with sector strength but stock-level divergence. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirming signs (1) Real Estate/Utilities/Materials leading while Technology and Financials are weak, and (2) major stock-level divergences among Big Tech/financial names versus broad sector gains. Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5: 3 Real Estate / 1 Technology / 1 Communication).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Real Estate leads: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND.  
Utilities & Materials also strong: EXC (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, AEP (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +9.09% | 1M: +10.21%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.18%) BELOW TREND.  
Financials lagging: C (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3/5 Real Estate-heavy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: SCHW (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -29.51%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -14.61%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: EQIX (1W: +12.74%), AMT (1W: +12.16%), ORCL (1W: +12.13%), CCI (1W: +11.75%), AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: MSFT (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%) RECOVERY, META (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +3.94%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: -4.95%) RECOVERY — this is a MAJOR divergence, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech is under pressure with mixed bounce candidates: ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND. Sector tone: negative on 1W (sector -1.88%) with patchy leadership — watch for follow-through from AMAT/ORCL.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are weak and dispersed: C (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION, JPM (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -1.73%) BELOW TREND. Sector tone: negative (1W: -4.45%) and a headwind for broad risk appetite.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed: JNJ (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) ABOVE TREND but with negative legal headline, PFE (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND. Sector is slightly negative on the week but contains pockets of strength and headline-driven divergence.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Real Estate and selected cyclicals (EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +21.49%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak Financials and pressured Tech names (AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -29.51%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt over Growth given current sector leadership and divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/legal clearance momentum; AEP (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND — earnings beat follow-through.  
BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND — post-weakness continuation risk; SCHW (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND — monitor financial flows.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Real Estate (breadth strength and big 1W gains) and Utilities (EXC (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: Technology and Financials — Tech has several large names under pressure while Financials show concentrated selling.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
EQIX near short-term continuation: monitor 1W breakout holds (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND.  
AAPL support risk: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND — further weakness would increase market risk.  
AMAT follow-through: AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold would signal false breakout.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMAT (+75): AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND — news clearing probe confirms price strength.  
EL (+75): EL (1W: +8.82% | 1M: -7.42%) RECOVERY — guidance beat but 1M softness suggests short-term rotation, monitor follow-through.  
CVX (+70): CVX (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND — macro energy re-engagement and price action aligned.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
JNJ (-85): JNJ (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) ABOVE TREND — verdict-driven negative headlines diverge from rising price (distribution risk).  
ORCL (-50): ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY — legal headlines are bearish but 1W rally shows short-term accumulation/divergence.  
AMT (-50): AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND — tenant/contract risk headlines conflict with strong price action.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Real Estate/Utilities/Materials leadership and mixed Tech/Financials. EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, EXC (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among big-cap Tech/Financial names and headline-driven sentiment (JNJ, ORCL, AMT) that could reverse narrow leadership; monitor MSFT (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%) RECOVERY and META (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +3.94%) CORRECTION for confirmation.
